Class UITheme

java.lang.Object
it.uninsubria.theknife.client.gui.UITheme
public final class UITheme extends Object
Design system TheKnife: colori, font, factory componenti. Tutti i componenti custom usano Java2D puro — zero dipendenza da font Unicode.
